column1: # IATA airport-code lookup for the Datamart's "flights to the event's city" feature.
#   - city : lowercase, no surrounding spaces. Match by normalising the event's
#            city the same way (lowercase + trim) before lookup.
#   - codes: comma-separated IATA codes, ordered nearest/most-relevant first.
#            Multiple codes = the city has several airports OR uses a nearby one.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Coverage targets the feeders' countries: Spain (ES), Italy (IT), France (FR).
